metric: finish-only completed-lap milliseconds on mutually finished identical road cells; local mirror proxy, not official rank
independent_verification: Verified protocol/actor/ledger/reset-intent SHAs, all 128 NPZ file hashes and raw float32 action-array SHAs, 256 reset-intent/end events, 32 identical paired road/obstacle/initial-observation fingerprints and 64 exact two-reload action-trace pairs against primary files.
decision: Reject brake-only inference change; leave the original DrQ actor and existing submission ZIP unchanged. Do not retune the threshold on these previously outcome-exposed development cells.
limitations: All 32 roads were previously consumed development; outcomes are not fresh or independent generalization evidence.
Track 1 prior diagnostic cap was 1,200 steps, versus this experiment's fixed 2,000; track 2 and 3 share eight geometry seeds.
Track 3 had zero CPU21 control finishes, so its speed and finish preservation cannot be estimated from this matched comparison.
Two faster mutually completed track-1 laps are conditional on only two finishers and cannot offset four lost finishes across track 1/2.
No official submission, model confirmation, blind partition, official map score, or deployment was performed.
